title: Google Hotels Prices & OTA Rate Tracker

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: What you would type into Google Hotels, e.g. 'hotels in Istanbul', 'hotels near Eiffel Tower', '5 star hotels in Dubai Marina'. One row per hotel per check-in date.

hotels.title: Specific hotels
hotels.description: Track specific hotels (e.g. your competitive set). Accepts a hotel name with city ('Hilton Istanbul Bomonti'), a Google Hotels URL, or a Google hotel ID (starts with 'Ch...', returned in the hotelId output field).

maxHotelsPerSearch.title: Max hotels per search query
maxHotelsPerSearch.description: How many hotels to collect for each search query and date (Google returns ~20 per page; the Actor paginates automatically).

checkInDate.title: Check-in date
checkInDate.description: First check-in date. Absolute (2026-12-20) or relative (+14 days, 2 weeks, tomorrow). Relative dates are ideal for scheduled runs.

nights.title: Nights (length of stay)
nights.description: Length of stay for every check-in date.

numberOfDates.title: Number of check-in dates (price calendar)
numberOfDates.description: Scrape prices for this many check-in dates starting from the check-in date. Example: 30 gives you a 30-day price calendar for every hotel.

dateStep.title: Days between check-in dates
dateStep.description: 1 = every day, 7 = same weekday every week.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult guests. Prices are for one room.

includeOtaOffers.title: Include all OTA offers
includeOtaOffers.description: Fetch every booking offer for each hotel (Booking.com, Expedia, Hotels.com, Agoda, Trip.com, official site...) with nightly and total prices, booking links, typical price range and tax breakdown. Turn off for a cheaper, faster run that returns only the lowest price from the search results.

includeRoomTypes.title: Include room types
includeRoomTypes.description: Adds room-level prices (e.g. 'Deluxe Double Room') from featured providers. Requires 'Include all OTA offers'.

country.title: Country (point of sale)
country.description: Two-letter country code Google uses as the point of sale (us, gb, de, tr...). Prices and the list of booking sites can differ by country.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for hotel descriptions and room names, e.g. en-US, de, tr, fr.

maxItems.title: Max results (0 = unlimited)
maxItems.description: Stop after this many rows. Useful to cap costs.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel requests to Google. Higher is faster; lower it if you see many retries.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Datacenter proxies work in most cases. Switch to residential if you see many failed requests.
